trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, in the official description's own words. This is a location moment, not a challenge: go to Ocean Beach, find the spot where the game offers the cocktail interaction (bars and beachfront venues are the obvious candidates), and take it. It takes a minute — do it the first time a story mission or a sunset drive puts you on Ocean Beach. trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 2 — Partner moments and one-off free-roam events
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, per the official description. Inside a vehicle showroom, take a car and drive it out through the glass rather than the door. Showrooms are in the rich districts; if the staff response raises heat, the trophy is about the exit, so make the exit first and worry about the escape after. trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 2 — Partner moments and one-off free-roam events
trophies.guide: 'A partnership with mass appeal' — the official description points at the partner characters and a public moment between them. This is one of the list's deliberately vague trophies: progress the two protagonists' shared story and partner activities, and it is expected to resolve through partnership content rather than a solo grind. If it has not popped by the endgame, revisit partner hangouts and photo-friendly activities with both protagonists together. Sources: PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase; PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 1 — The story: chapters and named missions in order
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse), says the official description — this is the list's clearest choice-based trophy, and the one this guide flags as missable. Keep a manual save before major story decisions from Chapter 2 onward, so a choice can be revisited if the trophy is tied to a particular path. If you finish the story without it, reload the decision save rather than restarting the game. Sources: PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase; PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 1 — The story: chapters and named missions in order
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — the official description implies an event that must be attempted, failed or missed, and then done again. Flagged watch-out here: when a story or activity moment clearly offers a second attempt after a first failure, take the retry instead of reloading a save to erase the failure, so the 'second time' can happen. If you are mid-cleanup without it, look for repeatable events whose first attempt you perfected — and deliberately take the second-chance route. Sources: PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase; PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 2 — Partner moments and one-off free-roam events
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — a deliberately hidden flavour trophy, the kind this series awards for a specific strange event. It cannot be planned from its description, so the practical guide is: interact with Leonida's oddities (the Truth-Is-Out-There style encounters, unusual strangers, unexplained events) whenever the game offers them instead of driving past. These trophies are designed to be stumbled into; breadth of exploration is the strategy. trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 2 — Partner moments and one-off free-roam events
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, per the official description. You need a vehicle, a group of pedestrians or enemies in the open, and a melee swing from the driver's seat as you pass. Set it up on a quiet road rather than in traffic chaos: approach slowly, swing through the group, and the trophy checks the melee drive-by itself, not the damage done. trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 5 — Money and property: laundering, spending, garages
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, the amount in the official description. Marked Bills come from robberies and operations, and laundering runs through your contacts, so this is a loop, not a single score: rob, launder, repeat, and prefer laundering over spending marked money elsewhere. Strand finales and vault robberies feed it fastest, which is why it sits in the money stage of the roadmap. Sources: PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase; PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 5 — Money and property: laundering, spending, garages
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, per the official description. This accumulates across every shop type — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services — so it finishes on its own in a long run. If you are short at cleanup time, vehicle upgrades and property furnishing burn money fastest; never sell-and-rebuy in a shop that does not count purchases, check the stat page instead. Sources: PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase; PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 5 — Money and property: laundering, spending, garages
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties, per the official description. Garages are bought on the property market, so this is gated by cash: finish the money loop (Dime on the Dollar) and the strand finales first, then buy every garage listing in one sweep. If a garage will not list, progress the story — property listings unlock in waves. trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.stageTitle: Stage 5 — Money and property: laundering, spending, garages
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, the count in the official description. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app instead of abandoning it; ten registrations accumulate quickly if you register every new model you discover for Whip It Good. The two trophies share a workflow, so do them together. Sources: PlayStation trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as listed by Exophase; PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list.
